_about: Names of the models the app has used, by file fingerprint (chc.ml.model_tag: first 8 hex of the file's sha1). A part's models are numbered in the order they went into the app: Guitar 1, Guitar 2, ... A side model for a style keeps its own count (Guitar Busy 1). A trained model that never went into the app has no name; it gets the next number when it is switched in, and its entry is added then. Names never change once given. Numbers 1-3 come from the app's saved snapshots (models/v1, v1-tuned, v2-final).
